LESSON: COORDINATES AND GRAPHS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.1 Geometrical Constructions (12 lessons) • parallel and perpendicula 
Topic 4.2: Coordinates and graphs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Coordinates and graphs, part of Geometry 4.1 Geometrical Constructions (12 lessons) • parallel and perpendicula  in Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we plot coordinates on a cartesian plane? 2. Where do we use linear graphs in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. draw a labelled cartesian plane on different learning materials,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Coordinates and graphs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify points on the cartesian plane in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Coordinates and graphs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. plot points on the cartesian plane in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Coordinates and graphs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. generate a table of values for a linear equation in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Coordinates and graphs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. determine an appropriate scale for a linear equation on the cartesian plane in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Coordinates and graphs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. draw a linear graph from table of values on cartesian plane in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Coordinates and graphs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. determine an appropriate scale for a linear equation on the cartesian plane in different situations,

F. draw a linear graph from table of values on cartesian plane in different situations,

   Coordinates and graphs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

G. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. draw and appropriately label the axes on the cartesian plane,

2. practice locating and plotting points on a cartesian plane appropriately,

3. discuss and read coordinates of points on the cartesian plane and write the coordinates in terms of (horizontal value, vertical value),

4. discuss, choose and use appropriate scale for a given data,

5. discuss and make an appropriate table of values for a given linear equation and draw the linear graphs,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. draw and appropriately label the axes on the cartesian plane,
2. practice locating and plotting points on a cartesian plane appropriately,
3. discuss and read coordinates of points on the cartesian plane and write the coordinates in terms of (horizontal value, vertical value),
4. discuss, choose and use appropriate scale for a given data,
5. discuss and make an appropriate table of values for a given linear equation and draw the linear graphs,
6. generate values in a table of the simultaneous linear equations and draw the 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Coordinates and graphs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: as the learner discusses and reads coordinates of points on the cartesian plane.

• Critical thinking and Problem solving: as the learner generates values in a table of the simultaneous linear equations.

• Digital literacy: as the learner learns and uses IT graphing tools to create linear graphs.

Values

Respect: is enhanced as the learner discusses and appreciate others’ views to make an appropriate table of values for a given

linear equation, and draws the linear graphs.
